description: Public profile records for each scraped Snapchat username, including bio, subscriber count, highlights, Spotlight videos, lenses, and related accounts.

activeStoryMeta.description: Story-level metadata for the active story: storyTitle, storySubtitle, emoji, storyTapId, canonicalUrlSuffix, videoTrackUrl, isAttributed

activeStorySnaps.description: Active 24-hour story snap records with mediaUrl and metadata (when includeActiveStory=true)

createdAt.description: Account creation timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC

curatedHighlights.description: Story highlights (each with highlightId, snapCount, storyTitle, thumbnailUrl, firstSnapUrl)

cursors.description: Pagination cursors for highlights and lenses (curatedHighlightsCursor, spotlightHighlightsCursor, lensCursor)

error.description: Error message if scraping failed for this username

hasCuratedHighlights.description: Whether the profile has curated highlights

hasSpotlightHighlights.description: Whether the profile has Spotlight highlights

hasStory.description: Whether the profile currently has an active story

isVerified.description: Whether the account has a verified badge

lastUpdatedAt.description: Profile last updated timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC

lenses.description: AR lenses created by this user (when includeLenses=true)

relatedAccounts.description: Related Snapchat accounts with username, displayName, and profile metadata

sameAsLinks.description: External social media links (raw API array)

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was scraped

shouldHideUsername.description: Whether username is hidden on profile (when present)

title: Snapchat Creator Profile & Highlights Extractor Output
